title: Full Stack Software Engineer
tagline: I build whole systems, end to end — web, mobile, AI agents and the operations around them — in whatever stack the problem needs.
summary: Full-stack engineer who builds the whole system a problem needs, in whatever stack it needs. Mostly that is software: web and mobile products, APIs and data models, payments, back-office consoles, and AI agents that do real work behind safety gates written in code. I also write the checks that judge AI output, such as a fact-check that holds any generated claim its source does not support, and tests that try to walk around a guard; I build test-first with AI coding agents, so their work is checked, not trusted. Around it sits the operation: search and AI visibility, store and CMS work, monitoring and process. I run an independent studio for clients in Nigeria and the Netherlands; in 2026 that meant a 733-product retail storefront and Dutch site, store and search work, alongside a live savings-circle product. In tech since 2010.
